metadata.goldstone:source:
# Double lines: every stroke style and line shape can be doubled; # `double_sep` sets the distance between the two lines (pt). format = 1
[style.dbl] double = true
[[vertex]] id = "a1" at = [0, 0] [[vertex]] id = "b1" at = [80, 0] [[edge]] from = "a1" to = "b1" class = "dbl" arrow = "forward" label = "plain"
[[vertex]] id = "a2" at = [0, -25] [[vertex]] id = "b2" at = [80, -25] [[edge]] from = "a2" to = "b2" class = "dbl" stroke = "dashed" double_sep = 4 label = "dashed, gap 4"
[[vertex]] id = "a3" at = [0, -55] [[vertex]] id = "b3" at = [80, -55] [[edge]] from = "a3" to = "b3" class = "dbl" stroke = "wavy" label = "wavy"
[[vertex]] id = "a4" at = [0, -90] [[vertex]] id = "b4" at = [80, -90] [[edge]] from = "a4" to = "b4" class = "dbl" stroke = "curly" double_sep = 3 label = "curly"
[[vertex]] id = "a5" at = [0, -125] [[vertex]] id = "b5" at = [80, -125] [[edge]] from = "a5" to = "b5" class = "dbl" stroke = "zigzag" double_sep = 4 label = "zigzag"
[[vertex]] id = "c" at = [120, -20] kind = "dot" [[vertex]] id = "e" at = [180, -20] kind = "dot" [[edge]] from = "c" to = "e" class = "dbl" bend = 60 arrow = "forward" label = "arc" [[edge]] from = "c" to = "e" class = "dbl" stroke = "wavy" bend = -60
[[vertex]] id = "f" at = [150, -110] kind = "dot" [[edge]] from = "f" to = "f" class = "dbl" double_sep = 2 loop = { radius = 15, angle = 90 } arrow = "forward" label = "loop"
